title: Notice what became normal
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Describe the routine — Include the private work between visible steps.; Ask what each step protects — Recover the current purpose rather than only the history.; Locate the important burden — Check recurrence and effects before redesigning.; Test a bounded change — Preserve necessary controls and inspect the result..
